# mtx-decompressor source availability

This directory contains the exact `mtx-decompressor` 1.8.0 distribution used by
the bundled PPTX viewer, including its MPL-2.0 license and the published
distribution files. The preferred source form is available from the upstream
repository at:

https://github.com/ChristopherVR/mtx-decompressor/tree/d818c57f494bd6ba103291a9d706def706992e5a

Release tag: `v1.8.0`

The source archive for this exact commit is:

https://github.com/ChristopherVR/mtx-decompressor/archive/d818c57f494bd6ba103291a9d706def706992e5a.tar.gz

Archive SHA-256: `983d8184fdbb9e6023c4d178f622ac10eb7d0dfb57d1c4eb44bc081021bbe761`

The corresponding npm package is pinned by the following integrity value:

`sha512-suXE376dUmLX4PPxSmVmdWvu09oeesqmlE5NfKjb6XIUpDRjF2Mn47kM8nXWRkHb3l7ac0P+Crp0J0O984imRQ==`

The vendored `src/` directory is the corresponding Source Code Form for this
version. The vendored `dist/` files are the published object form. The upstream
source repository is also offered as the preferred form for making modifications
under MPL-2.0.
